item.title: Cognitive Operator Atlas: which probes separate frontier LLMs across model families
item.description: An interactive atlas of 27 cognitive operators run on 9 frontier LLMs across 3 families: which probes show a capability cliff everywhere, which ones were only measuring in-context lookup, and why operator construction is the core input to harness design.

item.title: Limits from Task Partitioning and Communication Bottlenecks
item.description: A plain-language walk through our paper on the information-theoretic limits of multi-agent systems: every task has an indivisible core, splitting it costs an exponential penalty, talking between agents does not pay that penalty back, and only external feedback does.

item.title: Silicon Samples to Simulate
item.description: An interactive map of 132 papers on LLMs as survey respondents: why the idea took off, six ways it breaks, seven schools of fixes, and why I think SEM is the natural verifier.
